ask.title: Ask an expert or KVK
ask.subtitle: Ask a question about your crop. An agriculture expert on TerraByte will reply here.
ask.formHint: Describe what you see, since when, and what you have already done. A clear photo helps the expert.
ask.question: Your question
ask.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Leaf tips are turning yellow in my onion plot since last week…
ask.kvkHint: Questions addressed to a KVK are also read by TerraByte's experts.
ask.kvkEmptyHint: The KVK directory is being compiled; your question goes to TerraByte's experts.

mine.empty: You have not asked any questions yet.
mine.emptyBody: Ask a question and an expert's reply will appear here.

kvk.search: Search by KVK name, district or host organisation
kvk.emptyBody: Verified contact details of the Krishi Vigyan Kendras in Maharashtra are being collected from official sources and will appear here. Until then, your questions still reach TerraByte's experts.
kvk.nearestHint: Straight-line distance from your profile location. Most KVK map points are the village or town centre, not the KVK campus.
kvk.nearestNoLocation: Add your location in Settings to see the KVKs nearest to you.
kvk.approxLocation: Map point is approximate (village or town centre, not the KVK campus). Call before visiting.

thread.title: Question #{{id}}
thread.noMessagesFarmer: No reply yet. You will get a notification when an expert replies.
thread.claimed: The question is now assigned to you.
thread.claimHint: Take the question to reply. Other experts will then no longer see it in their list.
thread.closeBody: No more replies can be added once it is closed.
thread.reassignBody: The chosen expert and the farmer will be notified.
thread.noExperts: There are no other approved experts.

expertList.subtitle: Questions from farmers. Take a question to answer it.
expertList.emptyMine: You have not taken any questions yet.

adminList.title: Consultations
adminList.subtitle: All farmer questions, including those addressed to a KVK. Reassign them if needed.

articles.title: Expert articles
articles.subtitle: Articles written by agriculture experts on TerraByte.
articles.empty: No articles have been published yet.
articles.emptyBody: Articles from experts will appear here once they are published.
articles.draftNote: This is a draft. Farmers cannot see it until it is published.

expertArticles.title: Knowledge base
expertArticles.subtitle: Write articles for farmers. Only published articles are visible to them.
expertArticles.empty: You have not written any articles yet.
expertArticles.emptyBody: Write an article to share practical knowledge with farmers.
expertArticles.unpublishedToast: The article is now a draft.
expertArticles.deleteBody: The article will be removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
expertArticles.dialogHint: Write in plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs. Recommend doses or chemicals only with an official source.
expertArticles.publishedHint: When on, farmers can read the article.

kvkAdmin.title: KVK management
kvkAdmin.subtitle: The Krishi Vigyan Kendra directory shown to farmers. Enter only verified details with their source.
kvkAdmin.emptyBody: Import the verified list with the import command (see the import status page) or add entries one by one.
kvkAdmin.dialogHint: Name, district and state are required. Add the source page and the date you verified the details.

errors.url: Enter a full link starting with http:// or https://.

kvkAdmin.deleteBody: Questions that farmers addressed to this KVK keep their text and replies; they just lose the KVK link.

kvkStatus.title: KVK import status
kvkStatus.subtitle: What the KVK directory contains and when the verified list was imported.
kvkStatus.missingTitle: Maharashtra districts without a KVK entry
kvkStatus.allCovered: Every district has at least one KVK.
kvkStatus.noImports: No import has been run yet.
kvkStatus.noImportsBody: Run the import command below once the verified list is ready.
kvkStatus.howToTitle: How to import the verified list
kvkStatus.howToBody: In the backend folder, run the command below with a JSON file containing an array of KVK objects. Use --dry-run first to check the file without saving anything.
kvkStatus.howToMatch: Rows are matched on name, district and state: existing KVKs are updated, new ones added, invalid rows skipped and listed above.
